mito src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
[
	[1,2,3].parallel(v, v),

	{
		"one":1,
		"two":2,
		"three":3,
	}.parallel(k, v,
		{"key": k, "val": v}
	).transformMapEntry(_, v, 
		{v.key: v.val}
	),
]
-- want.txt --
[
	[
		1,
		2,
		3
	],
	{
		"one": 1,
		"three": 3,
		"two": 2
	}
]
